Bug_Details:
Overriding method is missing a call to overridden super method API providers may annotate a method with an annotation like
androidx.annotation.CallSuper or
javax.annotation.OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper to require that overriding
methods invoke the super method. This check enforces those annotations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded by suppressing the 'MissingSuperCall' warning using the '@SuppressWarnings' annotation. This allowed the code to compile without errors while still demonstrating the intentional bug.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the method `showBug` on an instance of `MissingSuperCallBug`, which in turn calls the method `methodA` that is missing the call to the super method.
